text:
Aisha: Heads up — StrataX portal is rejecting our PO with `ERR_NAMESPACE_V1`. Procurement can't move the HW order forward.
Ben: Which PO? link to the PO?
Aisha: PO# 2024-7890 — attached XML shows `<Invoice:Namespace>stratax.com</Invoice:Namespace>` but portal expects `stratax:sales`.
Clara: Finance needs a workaround, what's the timeline if we reissue?
Aisha: Procurement says vendor can't accept without corrected namespace; lead time becomes ~6 weeks if we re-submit from scratch.
Ben: @Evan can the integration team remap namespace at submit time? We did a transform for Atlas last quarter.
Evan: We have a quick client-side patch that rewrites the namespace before POST, but it alters the submitted payload and could complicate audit logs. Need legal sign-off.
Legal-Sara: Loop me in — I can draft a narrow amendment that authorizes canonicalization of invoice namespace for PO ingestion. Will add comments to clause 2.1.
MarketplaceBot: PO 2024-7890 ingestion failed — reason: invoice namespace mismatch. Ticket #MKP-4572 created.
Aisha: @Ben vendor tech says their EDI provider contract prevents them from changing expected namespace on their side short-term.
Ben: Can vendor accept a signed amendment (SOW addendum) that permits our namespace transform and confirms equivalence?
Legal-Sara: Yes — we can prepare an amendment. We'll need vendor counter-signature and Finance to accept the amendment as part of invoice processing.
Clara: If amendment is signed, Finance can route the invoice. Please confirm estimated turnaround for vendor signature.
Ben: Vendor estimates ~3 business days for counter-signature if language is standard and limited in scope.
Aisha: Plan: Legal to draft amendment (Sara), Evan to stage transform as a fallback, Ben to coordinate vendor sign-off, Clara to hold payment until amendment is in place. I'll update the deal desk tracker and procurement task.
Evan: Patch prototype posted to staging: `https://gitlab.com/rw/integrations/stratax/namespace-transform` — running E2E tomorrow AM.
Ben: Great — @Aisha ping me before you notify the customer. :thumbsup:
Aisha: Will do. Adding MKP-4572 to partnerships board and marking as "awaiting vendor signature." Thanks everyone.
